# Phase 6: Offensive Fundamentals

*Generated by `.portfolio/build_index.py`. Don't edit by hand.*

**🎓 Certification alignment:** this phase tracks eJPT's Host and Network Penetration Testing (35% of that exam) and Web Application Penetration Testing (15%) domains closely, and touches a genuine third of CEH v13's 20 modules — reconnaissance, scanning, system hacking, web/SQL injection, and cryptography specifically. Worth knowing: both eJPT and CEH added AI-assisted attacker tooling to their 2026 versions (AI-driven recon, AI-generated payloads) — this phase covers the classic manual technique first, on purpose, and the AI layer on top of it gets its own dedicated week later, in Phase 9.
